entities.summary: Jeffrey Philip Fiorentino is an American former professional baseball outfielder. He played in Major League Baseball (MLB) for the Baltimore Orioles and Oakland Athletics between 2005 and 2009. He also played in Nippon Professional Baseball (NPB) for the Hiroshima Toyo Carp in 2010. He was nicknamed Screech due to his resemblance to the character of the same name from the television sitcom Saved by the Bell.
